d:
Iran has claimed responsibility for an attack on a US military base in Bahrain, escalating tensions across West Asia. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said it launched six drones at the Al-Riffa helicopter base, while residents reported several blasts and air raid sirens across the Gulf nation. Bahrain's Interior Ministry has urged residents to take shelter.
The IRGC has warned that any further US aggression will trigger a 'harsher response'. Iran's attacks have disrupted shipping through the strategic waterway, raising concerns over global trade and energy supplies.
